---
title: "COVID-19 in Newfoundland and Labrador"
author: "John W"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(viridis)
library(gt)

# Load data
data <- read.csv(
  "https://health-infobase.canada.ca/src/data/covidLive/covid19-download.csv",
  na = "-"
)

# Filter/tidy data
df <- data |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  filter(prname == "Newfoundland and Labrador",
         totalcases > 0) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |>
  select(prname, date, totalcases)
```

## When were the first cases of COVID-19 reported in Newfoundland and Labrador?

```{r}
  df |>
    slice(1) |>
    gt()
```

The first 6 cases of COVID-19 in Newfoundland and Labrador were reported on **March 21, 2020.**
